Help bridge address: Searches for bridges via mDNS and the Hue discovery service, this takes about 5 seconds. The adapter must be running for this.
Help ignore groups: Rooms, zones and the "all" group will not be created
Help ignore scenes: Scenes and smart scenes will not be created
Help turn on with others: Lights are also turned on when color, color temperature or effect is changed
Instruction: Please press the link button of the bridge before create a new user!
No bridge address: Please enter the bridge address first
Turn on with others: Turn on with others than power and brightness
